name: Let us read
core_idea: scholar: a learned person I Doctor Dolittle was sitting in his kitchen talking with the Cat’s- food-Man who had come to see him with a stomach-ache.
supporting_evidence: “Why don’t you give up being a people’s doctor, and be an animal doctor?” asked the Cat’s-food-Man.
The parrot, Polynesia, was sitting in the window looking out at the rain and singing a sailor song to herself.

name: Let us discuss
core_idea: I Complete the following sentence by selecting a suitable reason.
supporting_evidence: The Cat’s-food-Man suggests to Doctor Dolittle that he should become an animal doctor because he believes that Dolittle ______________________________________________________.
earns less fee by treating human patients 2.

name: Let us discuss
supporting_evidence: Share your answers with your classmates and the teacher.
Doctor Dolittle decides to stop being a doctor for people and becomes a doctor for animals.

name: Let us learn
core_idea: I Read the following words from the text.
supporting_evidence: Compound words are formed by combining two words of different parts of speech to create a new word that has an entirely new meaning.
They are of three types─hyphenated (Cat’s-food-Man), open compound words (bird language) and closed compound words (flowerpots).

name: Let us listen
core_idea: I You will listen to an announcement.
supporting_evidence: As you listen, state whether the following statement is true or false.
Dolittle’s new clinic presents an offer of free medicines.

name: Let us explore
core_idea: I The word ‘goshala’ translates to ‘cowshed’ in English.
supporting_evidence: It is a Sanskrit word that is made up of the words ‘go’, which means ‘cow’, and śālā, which means ‘shed’ or ‘hall’.
Plan a visit with the teacher to a ‘goshala’ and find out how the cows are looked after.
